headline: Cisco and OpenAI launch open-source initiative to shield against AI-powered cyberattacks
summary: Cisco and OpenAI have launched the Secure Infrastructure Project, an open-source initiative. It aims to help security teams protect their systems against cyberattacks using AI.
why: Cisco is a large networking and cybersecurity company, and OpenAI develops widely used AI models. Cybersecurity spending and AI-related risks are important themes for technology investors.
original_headline: Cisco y OpenAI lanzan iniciativa de código abierto para blindarse ante ciberataques con IA
